meta.name: Generate Image (P-H3 Image)
meta.licenseNote: MiniMax H3 Community License (MiniMax, 2026), PrunaAI's P-H3-Image repack under the same terms: the grant excludes the EU, the UK, South Korea and the USA; over USD 1M yearly revenue or a hosted service needs MiniMax's OK; show "Powered by MiniMax H3"; outputs may not train other models. Bring your own files. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: Runs natively (genai-native gn-diffusion p-h3-image/image, qwen-image-rs h3): PrunaAI's P-H3-Image (the 33B MiniMax H3 DiT sampling a still as one video latent frame and two audio latents), its Qwen3-VL-4B encoder read at hidden states 13/19/25/31/36 through the text connector, PrunaAI's 8 fixed sigmas at shift 1, Euler, no CFG, the tiled ViT VAE decode. Sides multiples of 32; the model's own default is 2912x2912 (8.5 MP).

meta.description: Large open model for detailed pictures up to 8 MP (5090 class)
